optional_baselines_reason: 192 required episodes; optional force and axial baselines add 128 episodes (~67% collection time). Prioritize all 64 fresh paired conditions.
condition_selection: Fixed structured design. No outcome-dependent tuning, exclusions, substitutions, stopping, or repeats.
geometry_scope: 64 new imposed contact paths on unchanged FORGE peg/socket assets; no clearance variation.

analysis.primary: Paired insertion success v2 versus v1, all 64 conditions; all failures retained.
analysis.severe_definition: Preassigned upper level in each non-control family, including terminal-band and late-ramp strata; 28 conditions, independent of observed outcomes.
analysis.paired_test: Two-sided exact conditional McNemar/binomial on discordant success pairs, p=1 if none.
analysis.bootstrap: Paired condition resampling, stratified by the eight predeclared families; 95% percentile CI for success-rate difference. Descriptive structured-design uncertainty.
analysis.strict_match: All samples of the common prefix through the earlier first intervention (or earlier episode end) pass original FORGE pose, velocity, joints, wrench, load and grasp replay tolerances. No tolerances changed.
analysis.coverage: Safe shadow alarms replayed on identical nominal histories; failed nominal trajectories form denominator. No future data enter detector.
analysis.unnecessary: Shadow alarm on subsequently successful nominal history; actual interventions on paired nominal successes reported separately, with strict-match sensitivity.
analysis.lead: Nominal first-stall and safety-stop time minus first safe shadow alarm; positive means earlier. Report safety lead >=0.1s; terminal opportunity delay separately.
analysis.secondary: Severe subset, safety, timeouts, coverage, false interventions, branch counts and lead are descriptive; no multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claims.
